statement: I approve all these designs, with the exception of this one that I attached.
attributedScope: Accept seven of the eight R6 alarm/Postpone visual templates. Reject the undecorated generic R6-04. All native full-screen alarm states must support the four global Sunrise/Sky/Evening/Night atmospheres with shared layout and independent brightness, including the privacy-safe before-first-unlock view.
conditions: Apply documented neutral icon roles, shared theme surfaces/type/component geometry and measured footer/target/scroll rules rather than incidental raster differences.

Pre-first-unlock reminder text remains generic. Theme scenery/colors must use bundled content-independent assets and a reviewed native-safe appearance source, without private reminder data or credential-storage reads.
Support all four atmospheres in Light/Dark for single, multiple, loading and retained-error native alarm states; a full image matrix of every variation is not required by this approval.
limits: Newly generated themed R6-04 replacement pixels have not been approved.
No final artwork/production-token or actual RN/Compose render acceptance.
No authorization to execute P04/P07/P08 production work, choose storage schema/migration/period defaults, install/distribute or change milestone status.
No accessibility, scheduling, Direct Boot or physical-device verification implied.

subsequentRefinement.statement: The black color you are using it too contrasty. Refer to the previous styles where a softer black is used. Make sure to match the color and style of the existing themes!
subsequentRefinement.scope: Use the existing atmosphere's softer charcoal/slate/plum/navy surface roles. Revise four new Dark replacement candidates; no independently redesigned alarm palette.
